program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15.0, 8.0, 20.0),      # gain NMOS gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.4, 0.15, 1.0),       # gain NMOS L
    "I1":    (36e-6, 15e-6, 38e-6),  # CS branch current
    "Rf":    (160e3, 135e3, 260e3),  # feedback resistor
    "Cf":    (8e-15, 1e-15, 60e-15), # feedback cap (peaking control)
    "gmidp": (7.0, 5.0, 12.0),       # PMOS load gm/Id (low -> low noise)
    "Lp":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # PMOS load / mirror L
    "kbr":   (0.25, 0.1, 1.0),       # bias branch current = kbr*IREF
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cpd = spec.get("cpd", 5e-13); cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    I1, Rf, Cf = p["I1"], p["Rf"], p["Cf"]
    Ibr = p["kbr"] * iref

    # Gain device: drain = vout, DC vout = vgs1 (no DC current in Rf)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.5)
    vout_dc = m1.vgs
    # PMOS current-source load
    m2 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=vdd - vout_dc)
    # PMOS diode for mirror (same gm/Id, L)
    m5 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Ibr, vds=m2.vgs)
    # NMOS reference diode on ibias and its mirror (same gm/Id, L)
    Ln, gn = 1.0, 12.0
    m3 = lut.size("n", gn, Ln, iref, vds=0.6)
    m4 = lut.size("n", gn, Ln, Ibr, vds=vdd - m5.vgs)

    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M3", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m4)
    n.dev("M5", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", m5)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", m2)
    n.dev("M1", "vout", "iin", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.R("RF", "iin", "vout", Rf)
    n.C("CF", "iin", "vout", Cf)

    # ---- analytic predictions ----
    gm = m1.gm
    Go = m1.gds + m2.gds
    G = 1.0 / Rf
    Cin = cpd + max(m1.cgg - m1.cgd, 0.0)
    Cft = Cf + m1.cgd
    CLt = cl + m1.cdd + m2.cdd

    f = np.logspace(5, 9.5, 4000)
    s = 2j * PI * f
    Y = G + s * Cft
    det = (Y + s * Cin) * (Go + Y + s * CLt) + Y * (gm - Y)
    zt = np.abs((gm - Y) / det)
    z0 = zt[0]
    idx = np.where(zt < z0 / math.sqrt(2))[0]
    f3db = float(f[idx[0]]) if len(idx) else float(f[-1])

    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300.15
    gam = 0.8
    w1 = 2 * PI * 1e6
    # Rf thermal
    in2 = 4 * kT / Rf
    # PMOS load current noise referred to iin node: i_n2 / (gm1*Rf)
    in2 += 4 * kT * gam * m2.gm / (gm * Rf) ** 2
    # M1 voltage noise times admittance at the iin node
    en2 = 4 * kT * gam / gm
    in2 += en2 * ((w1 * (Cin + Cft)) ** 2 + G ** 2)
    noise = math.sqrt(in2)

    power = vdd * (iref + Ibr + I1)
    return n, {
        "zt_dbohm": db(z0),
        "f3db": f3db,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vout_dc,
        "in_noise_1m": noise,
    }
